registered_at: 2026-09-19 (DRAFT — launch_allowed=false until MS-141 is recorded and the evidence detector is fixed)
question: Given the same LLM, the same sequential-evidence QA v1 data, and the same injected-token budget, does a learned event memory answer 'what changed earlier, when, and where is the evidence' better — and keep its judgment stable under cloudy or irrelevant arrivals — than (a) reading only the latest observation, (b) reading the T1 updated cache, or (c) reading a rule-based event log built from the cross-region sealed readout?
detector_for_evidence: event_log_v1 (sealed cross-region readout on causal prefix states); the hiroshima-trained head is NOT used (MS-140/141)
data: sequential_qa_v1 (MS-138): per-arrival-step items with state/when/where/update labels; hiroshima blocks for train/val/test-in-event; thrissur/itogon/hokkaido as unseen events

arms.A_latest_only: OLMo + projector reads the latest single-observation tokens (64) + dates text
arms.B_t1_cache: reads the Δt-GRU (MS-116 recipe) updated state tokens (64) + dates text
arms.C_rule_log: reads the latest-observation tokens (64) + a text serialisation of event_log_v1 up to the current step (dates, area, quadrants above the region's validation threshold)
arms.D_learned_memory: reads the T1 state tokens (64) + K=4 learned event-memory slots (written by a quality- and change-conditioned writer from single-observation tokens; slots hold pooled tokens + date embedding), same total token budget as C

training: S1 projector-only alignment on train items (state question), then S2 LoRA r=16 on OLMo for all four question types; identical epochs/budget across arms; seed 1; GPU1
metrics: Q_update: action accuracy, with the cloud-stability sub-metric = fraction of 'keep/abstain' steps where the model does NOT change its state answer
all reported in-event (hiroshima test block) and on the three unseen events

decision_rules.method_claim: D beats C on Q_when AND Q_update cloud-stability on >= 2 of 3 unseen events with tile-paired CI excluding 0, at equal token budget
decision_rules.system_only: D ~ C: the contribution is the benchmark + system (no learned-memory method claim)
decision_rules.memory_irrelevant: A >= all others on Q_state/Q_when: past evidence is recoverable from the latest observation alone; the memory line is closed

prerequisites_before_launch: event_log_v1 thresholds fixed per region on validation
token-budget parity check between C and D
